اعتزمنا (form VIII)
# اِعْتَزَمْنَا (iʕtazamnā) /iʕ.ta.zam.naː/: first-person plural past active of اِعْتَزَمَ (iʕtazama)
# اُعْتُزِمْنَا (uʕtuzimnā) /uʕ.tu.zim.naː/: first-person plural past passive of اِعْتَزَمَ (iʕtazama)
